 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SOURENDRA PANDEY  ORAL ORDER 3 05-02-2026

Learned counsel for the petitioner seeks permission to add the informant as opposite party no.2.
2. Permission is accorded.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner is directed to add the informant as opposite party no.2 during the course of the day.
4. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.P.P. for the State.
5.
The present application has been filed by the petitioner invoking the inherent jurisdiction of this Hon'ble Patna High Court CR.

MISC. No.4283 of 2024(3) dt.05-02-2026 Court for quashing the FIR bearing Sangrampur P.S. Case No. 202 of 2022 dated 02.08.2022 registered for the offences under Sections 406, 420, 504, 506, 34 of the Indian Penal Code.

6. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that from the perusal of the FIR, it would be evident that it is on account of some dispute with regard to the distribution of money among the partners that the present false and concocted FIR has been lodged.

It has further been submitted that it would be evident from the FIR that a reference to a partnership deed and the distribution of money Amrendra Shekha Singh vs The State Of Bihar on 5 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/27897509/
1 through various accounts has been referred to, which goes on to show that this was a civil dispute between the parties which has been given a criminal color.
